title: Vanguard Mission
description: Requirements for promotion to the rank of Vanguard.
body:
To advance from Shieldbearer to Vanguard, you must first earn 8 Scrolls of Heroic Deeds while having served as Shieldbearer.

Once the required deeds have been earned, a Warden will announce your advancement and issue you your Vanguard mission. Your mission must be declared in the Great Hall before you may begin.

Complete one of the following:
- Together with at least one other Gryphon, defeat a boss that presents a reasonable challenge for your character's level.
or...
- Fully unlock the bestiary entries of three creatures appropriate to your character's level. This challenge may be undertaken alone.

Upon completion, return to the Great Hall and present a screenshot as proof of your deeds. You may then be promoted to Vanguard.
